description: The sixth season explores reality entertainment, identity projection, altered crops, artificial children, time travel and future political control before closing with a two-part trial over whether dangerous technology should exist at all.

s06e01.description: A reality programme turns convicted killers into prey for victims' relatives, and the drive for ratings steadily erodes any distinction between justice, revenge and entertainment.

s06e02.description: An abusive ex-con buys a weapon to murder his wife, only for the gun to bond physically with him and begin transforming both his body and intentions.

s06e03.description: A holographic disguise device lets two lonely friends borrow glamorous identities for a night, but one becomes unwilling to return to his ordinary life when the illusion offers everything he wanted.

s06e04.description: A science vessel boards an abandoned warship found near a devastated planet and discovers that the derelict craft still contains a dangerous alien presence.

s06e05.description: A disgraced scientist uses his time machine to prove his theories and witnesses his wife's future death, along with evidence that his own actions may cause it.

s06e06.description: A man blind since childhood regains his sight through an experimental procedure and begins receiving visual messages from an alien trapped on Earth.

s06e07.description: A veterinarian connects a wave of aggressive tumours in a farming community to genetically engineered corn and a biological change spreading through the food chain.

s06e08.description: An engineer recreates his dead son inside a sophisticated robot using stored memories, and the artificial child begins challenging what grief has allowed his creator to build.

s06e09.description: In a resource-limited future where alternating work shifts sleep in stasis, a man and woman from opposite schedules fall in love and attempt to escape a system that keeps them apart.

s06e10.description: Alien enthusiasts gather at a convention where an attendee arrives with what appears to be genuine spacecraft debris, turning harmless obsession into a dangerous first-contact event.

s06e11.description: After a violent attack, a woman learns that she once had a conjoined twin sacrificed to save her life and begins feeling the dead sister's personality taking control.

s06e12.description: A man plagued by disturbing memories discovers that he is an autonomous android originally built for dangerous rescue work and must decide what to do with a life never intended to be his own.

s06e13.description: A visitor from the future must persuade a presidential candidate to jump from an aircraft, while every instinct and adviser around the politician tells him the demand is insane.

s06e14.description: A future salvage crew discovers a pod containing the preserved body of a legendary mass murderer supposedly executed generations earlier, reopening a political conflict thought long buried.

s06e15.description: A man returns to his hometown and finds it covered in antenna towers with residents behaving as if their minds are linked to an invisible network.

s06e16.description: A fraudulent revival preacher discovers that a mysterious young man can perform real healings and is tempted to turn genuine miracles into the most profitable act of his career.

s06e17.description: Two Civil War enthusiasts are transported to the Battle of Gettysburg and encounter another time traveller whose mission could alter both the battle and modern history.

s06e18.description: A teenager becomes suspicious of the stranger renting his mother's backyard apartment as townspeople begin disappearing around a supposedly ordinary new factory project.

s06e19.description: A bomber prepares to destroy a powerful government computer network, while the events leading to the attack reveal how technological control and resistance pushed him to the brink.

s06e20.description: Researchers at an Arctic station uncover ancient polar mites that infest humans and trigger madness, turning isolation into a rapidly escalating biological threat.

s06e21-22.description: In a future society that has outlawed advanced technology, scientist Theresa Givens stands trial for using a time machine and must defend not only herself but humanity's right to scientific knowledge.
